name: Rift bomber
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, its skin cracked with violet-pink rift light, a lumpy sack of smouldering black bombs with short lit fuses slung over its shoulder, a bomb held in one claw

poses.stand: hovering on spread bat wings, the bomb sack on its shoulder, a smouldering bomb held out in one claw
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: hovers, juggling a smouldering bomb with a hissing fuse

attack.action: takes a smouldering bomb from its sack and drops it down in front of it to the right, cackling

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
